reviews.title: This app possibly works on background
reviews.text:
For a few minutes, my iPhone suddenly stopped working on both Wi-Fi and 5G, even though the signal strength showed full bars. I tried everything, from restarting the phone to resetting network settings ;but nothing worked. Calls were fine, but all data-related functions were completely blocked.

The moment I deleted this VPN app, everything started working instantly. It’s quite concerning that an app can interfere with the device’s connectivity in the background like this.
